cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 2080: 30 displayed points from 208 checkpoints (cap 30). Adjacent checkpoints averaged for display; first/latest remain exact. Recent detail covers generations 1880–2080: all 21 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 143.365, interval [104.054, 179.163]. Paired change versus generation 2070: -1.272, 95% interval [-44.583, 30.426]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 26,624 games; 208 rated checkpoints. g1290 anchor 0.
